graph.name: 10. Decide whether this scene needs a recap
graph.description:
Learn to ask a model a small yes-or-no question. This lesson adds a recap only when the reply contains enough completed actions to make one helpful.

What you'll learn:
• Use Decision when a question needs an understanding of the text.
• Handle yes, no, and an uncertain answer separately.

Before you start:
• Open this lesson in a practice chat and enable Lattice before Send. The main reply uses your current SillyTavern connection.
• Use the Branch and Join ideas from lesson 9. Decision and Extract need model connections; choose Active SillyTavern on their node bars to use your current connection.

Steps:
1. Read the question in Decision. It asks whether the reply contains at least three distinct completed actions worth recapping.
2. Send a message that invites several actions in the scene. Draft Text makes the reply readable by Decision; Select Fields picks out its answer.
3. Inspect Decision’s result at out. In answers → recap → accepted, true means yes, false means no, and null means the model could not decide.
4. Follow Branch’s chosen path. Yes asks Extract for a recap and appends it as notes. No keeps the original reply. An uncertain answer also keeps the reply, without presenting a recap as confirmed.
5. Review the final reply and any proposed saved changes at Review / Publish. Choose Apply reviewed candidate to accept them, or Reject candidate to discard them. Preview alone does not save changes.

Checkpoints:
Decision → out: You can see both the model’s answer and whether it is certain enough to use.

Try this:
Change the question to require five completed actions.
The same scene may no longer qualify for a recap. Compare the answer and the path that Branch chooses.

If something is different:
The answer is false or null: The reply stays available for review without a recap.

Model requests: Up to two extra model requests: one to decide, then one to extract a recap if the answer is yes. SillyTavern writes one reply.

recap.instructions: Does this scene contain at least three distinct completed actions that would benefit from a short public recap? Answer null when unclear.

recap.title: Extract
recap.instructions: Return concise records of the distinct public actions in this exact narrative with literal evidence.
